name: O-1 the whole run counted, not its overlap
O-2 a run touching the window at one instant counted
O-3 a missing reading counted as zero
old: full = [(m, u) for _, m, u in chosen if m is not None and u is not None]
new: full = [(m or 0.0, u or 0.0) for _, m, u in chosen]

name: O-4 a line whose time is not a number skipped, not refused
old: raise ValueError(f"{path} (gpu_trace.csv line {number}) is not a reading: {line!r}") from None
